title: Under COMMA_SEPARATED, four of five strings come back as different types
rationale: parseAtomicValue is a type-guessing function with no schema and no escape hatch. Strings that are indistinguishable from literals - the exact set vd-string-literal-lookalikes proves safe on the default path - are silently retyped here. Same library, same document, opposite behaviour, selected by an enum that reads like a formatting choice.
catchesBugClass: Unguarded type inference on delimited formats - five distinct coercions in one assertion. A fix that addresses only the boolean case will still fail here.
cannotCatch: Cannot separate the value coercion from the structural change in a single assertion. It also does not reach parseAtomicValue quote-stripping branch, which only fires for BRACKET_LIST.

predicted.detail: Quoting is gone after flattening, so nothing downstream can know these were strings; parseAtomicValue then returns a boolean, a null, an int with leading zeros dropped, a double with the trailing zero gone, and one surviving String.
